title: Contextual body plus explicit vowel continuation: complete proposed teaching writer
scope: Artificial source writer, not a native alphabet, phonetic assignment, historical attestation or translation.
question: Can a body/continuation frame with a last-vowel memory reduce source concentration while keeping plausible word lengths?

input.contract: Use every existing stored word in all1054 recipes, unchanged. One recipe is an explicit output paragraph. One nonempty source word makes one nonempty group; spaces and paragraph boundaries remain. No new normalization, omitted words, guessed vowels, source parsing or dictionary meanings.
input.unsupported: Any other character makes this control unscorable for coverage, never silently transliterated. The82-character input inventory is inherited from935, not selected from new measurements.

body_assignment.interpretation: Remove the one display space to obtain18 consonants in this fixed order. These pair one-to-one with the first18 body signs; the19th is the isolated-vowel carrier.
body_assignment.atoms: Exactly22 stipulated working drawings; multi-letter labels such as ch name one artificial unit. Numeric IDs retain atom boundaries. This is no claim that native transcription has a proved22-unit alphabet.
body_assignment.escaped_consonants: j has the complete body q,o,a; w has q,o,n. These bodies still receive the ordinary continuation marks.
body_assignment.literal_escapes: Each of the56 additional input characters is q,o,d,B_hi,B_lo, where its zero-based index is19*hi+lo and B denotes the19-sign body list. An out-of-range index is illegal. These literal escapes receive no continuation mark and do not change vowel memory. Thus all82 characters and rare names are fully paid. q is never an ordinary body and is always immediately followed by o.

atomization: Scan each source word left-to-right. A lowercase consonant takes exactly its immediately following lowercase vowel if present; otherwise its continuation is NONE. A vowel not just consumed is one isolated-vowel carrier with that vowel. Each additional character is a literal escape. Do not consume past a source-word boundary.
state: Keep the last decoded lowercase vowel, one of a/e/i/o/u/y. Start every recipe at a. Update immediately after each vowel-bearing unit, including isolated vowels; bare consonants and literal escapes preserve it. Never reset at a source space or physical line wrap.

default_table.rows: Each of20 lowercase consonants plus the vowel carrier, each under6 entry-vowel states:126 cells.
default_table.training: Count complete body/continuation events only in all stored b4 and w1 recipes, in their existing order and with the declared source-driven vowel state. At each cell choose the most frequent continuation. Ties use NONE,a,e,i,o,u,y order. For carrier rows NONE is illegal and ties use a,e,i,o,u,y. An unseen consonant row defaults to NONE; an unseen carrier row to a. No target counts, bs1/gr1 counts, keys or manual cell repairs participate.
default_table.price: Both writers must know the same126 default values. The remaining assignments follow one fixed continuation order. This is a table-bearing construction, not a claim of merely22 memorized alphabet values or demonstrated medieval convenience.

continuation_marks: Default continuation emits no mark. Remove that default from the ordered list NONE,a,e,i,o,u,y; the six remaining entries get respectively e,ee,eee,i,ii,iii. A carrier's NONE remains illegal even if assigned a formal mark. Thus marks are not globally prefix-free; complete body/mark frames provide their boundaries.
carrier_omission: Only at the very beginning of a written word, an isolated-vowel carrier is obligatorily omitted if its continuation mark is nonempty. The resulting leading run unambiguously implies that carrier. If its mark is empty, the carrier must be written. All other bodies and carriers are always written in full. No repeated-body suppression.
reading: At group start a run of e or i alone implies one carrier. Otherwise consume one ordinary body or a fixed q,o escape. A j/w escape is a consonant body; a five-sign literal escape emits its exact character immediately.

After a body consume the maximal immediately following run over e/i. It must be empty or one kind repeated at most3 times. Look up the default using this body and current vowel state, then apply the fixed mark order. Emit the consonant plus optional vowel, or the carrier vowel. Update state on decoded vowels.

Reject a missing/invalid q guard or selector, incomplete escape, unsupported digit index, mixed/too-long mark run, or NONE carrier. Source spaces are preserved. Re-encode each decoded recipe by the same deterministic rules to reject noncanonical alternate segmentations or illegal carrier omissions.
No original source fragments, word dictionary or hidden word boundaries are supplied to the inverse. The published learned default table is the complete shared key.

manual_checks_before_counts.boundaries: Bodies contain neither e nor i; escaped-body length is fixed after q,o. Therefore a maximal modifier run has one owning body. An initial run has exactly the stated carrier. A carrier with no visible mark is never deleted, so an initial vowel cannot disappear.
manual_checks_before_counts.repetition: For a word containing a vowel, its final vowel fixes the state for its next occurrence. The second and third immediately repeated occurrences therefore have identical spellings. A vowel-free word preserves its entry state, hence all its adjacent occurrences agree. There is no single universal REPEAT word.
manual_checks_before_counts.new_names: An invented nara has two bodies, n+a then r+a. No name dictionary or established meaning is needed. A long open word simply contains more complete cells; actual length costs are measured, not assumed to fit.
manual_checks_before_counts.frozen_teaching_fixture: Under the declared fallback table (all consonants NONE, every carrier a), lege lege salz. writes cells [l,ee][y,ee] | [l,ee][y,ee] | [ch,e][l][cph][q,o,d,a,sh]. The full stop is additional index14. This illustrative fallback table is for parser checking only; the scientific source run uses the126 learned b4/w1 defaults.
manual_checks_before_counts.known_broken_shortcut: Omitting repeated bodies can make bb and c identical in the earlier body-feature lesson. The present contract never omits a consonant body or a noninitial carrier. It does not reuse that lossy shortcut.

predecessor_distinction: 1180's97 learned spelling units, state/rank alphabets and42–252 correspondences all fail. Here source units are fixed CV cells with a zero-or-explicit continuation in a body frame; this changes lengths and internal construction, not a row permutation or extra previous-vowel state alone.

892/895/905/906 use a single global inherent vowel and globally prefix-free1/2-unit component codes. Here context/body defaults vary, modifier codes can be prefix-related, and a disjoint body family delimits them. Their exact failures remain; no native Latin/Simon inverse is reopened.

1196's fixed vowel-run pieces and tiny preceding-ending states changed written word boundaries and failed. This writer preserves source word boundaries and assigns every consonant/vowel explicitly; no deleted grammar or new fragment boundary is fitted.

1202 bounds one/two spellings per whole source word. Here six entry-vowel states can change several initial cells before the first vowel, with possible contextual mergers. Its bound is not silently lifted; this contract needs its own fixed frequency screen.
1217's fixed22-ring failed length dispersion. The new CV atomization and variable-length modifiers can change the length histogram itself. No new ring key or renaming is offered as a repair.
